HostAuth.description: How to authenticate pack downloads from one host.

env.description: Environment variable holding the token, e.g. `GITHUB_TOKEN`.

scheme.description: Text before the token in the header; empty sends the token alone.

SigningConfig.description: Which pack signatures to trust; official packs ship inside tfverse and need none.

keys.description: Trusted minisign public keys by name, e.g. `acme = "RWQ…"`.

require.description: Refuse packs without a valid signature from a trusted key.

revoked.description: Ids of keys whose signatures are refused even when valid, e.g. `"F7C5EF0A9B1D2E3C"`.

description: The user's own config, outside every project: `<config dir>/tfverse/config.toml`.

ast_grep.description: The ast-grep program for pack migrations, e.g. `["bunx", "@ast-grep/cli"]`; default `ast-grep`.

auth.description: Credentials for pack downloads by host, e.g. `github.com`; the token comes from an environment variable.

patchers.description: Your preferred external tool per patch kind.

title: UserConfig
